# DeepSeek V4 Flash 知识图谱

## 模型训练与提升路径
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    PT[Pretraining] --> FW[Fixed Weights]
    FW --> MOE[MOE Architecture]
    MOE --> AP[Activation Params 130B]
    AP --> LCC[Lower Compute Cost]
    FW --> PT2[Post-Training]
    PT2 --> SD[Synthetic High‑Quality Data]
    SD --> RM[Improved Reward Model]
    RM --> RL[Advanced RL Algorithm]
    RL --> APF[Higher Agent Performance]
    RL --> CG[Better Code Generation]
    APF --> CG
```

## 参数规模与性能对比
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    VP[V4 Pro Preview] --> TP1[Total Params 1.6T]
    TP1 --> AP1[Active Params 490B]
    AP1 --> HC[High Cost]
    VF[V4 Flash] --> TP2[Total Params 284B]
    TP2 --> AP2[Active Params 130B]
    AP2 --> LC[Low Cost]
    VF --> SA[Same Architecture]
    SA --> PTB[Post‑Training Boost]
    PTB --> AB[Agent Benchmarks (Terminal 82.7%)]
    PTB --> CB[Code Benchmarks (SW_E 54.4%)]
    AB --> OP[Overall Performance Comparable]
    CB --> OP
```

## 成本与定价机制
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    MOE[MOE Activation 130B] --> RC[Reduced Compute per Inference]
    RC --> IU[Infrastructure Optimization]
    IU --> LUC[Lower Unit Compute Cost]
    LUC --> PS[Pricing Strategy]
    PS --> ICH[Input Cache Hit 0.5 $/M]
    PS --> IM[Input Miss 1 $/M]
    PS --> OUT[Output 2 $/M]
    PS --> CP[Competitive Pricing vs LUNA / GPT‑5.6 / COPUS5]
    CP --> HF[High‑Frequency Use Cases]
    HF --> DA[Developer Adoption]
```
